chunks: From him, from Faḍālah, from Ibn Sinān, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:

If a man sleeps or forgets to perform the Maghrib and the later ʿIshāʾ, then if he wakes before dawn with enough time to perform both of them, let him perform both of them. If he fears that one of them will escape him, then let him begin with ʿIshāʾ. And if he wakes after dawn, then let him perform the Ṣubḥ, then the Maghrib, then the ʿIshāʾ, before the rising of the sun.
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if someone sleeps through or forgets Maghrib and ʿIshāʾ prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding missed Maghrib and ʿIshāʾ prayers due to sleep or forgetfulness. It explains the order in which the prayers should be performed depending on whether one awakens before or after fajr, emphasizing timely recovery of the missed salat.
